text:
Priya Rao: Heads-up — BigBank (POC) just asked for a compliance package we need to hand over to procurement legal. They specifically want: SOC 2 Type II report (redacted ok), ISO scope statement, pen-test attestation/letter, and a short SOW on data residency. They want a deliverable by EOD Friday. Can we compile what’s shareable without an NDA and what requires their legal?

Alex Kim: We can share a redacted SOC2 exec summary and our standard pen-test attestation proactively. Full reports and control matrices are NDA-only. For pricing: if POC needs Dedicated capacity we'll need to attach a draft quote — but that can be a separate artefact.

Emma Torres: I’ll own assembling the package. Plan: (1) redacted SOC2 exec summary + system description, (2) pen-test attestation template, (3) short SOW stub for data residency, (4) guidance note on what’s NDA-only. I’ll drop links to the docs here when ready. ETA: 36 hours.

Marco Li: Quick security note — before sending anything non-redacted we need a signed evidence disclosure addendum. If BigBank insists on full artifacts prior to NDA, escalate to legal. Pen-test attestation we sign off internally; attachable file name: `pen-test-attestation-template.pdf`. :thumbsup:

Jordan Patel: From controls side — SOC2 Type II full report and control mapping are NDA-only. We can provide a redacted System Description + checklist that shows scope and major controls. Also can produce a mapping CSV for their auditors once NDA in place.

Priya Rao: Thanks. I’ll request their legal timeline and confirm whether redacted docs suffice. Asking procurement: can you accept a redacted SOC2 + pen-test letter to unblock procurement review? If not, I’ll push for an NDA today.

BigBank Legal (via email forwarded): "Procurement needs at least the SOC2 executive summary and a pen-test attestation to start our vendor risk review. Full reports will be under NDA. Can you send the SOW and residency note ASAP?"

Emma Torres: Uploaded initial drafts to internal bucket and prepared a short SOW template. Public-share links (redacted permissions): https://redwood.internal/compliance/redacted-soc2-exec-summary-2026 and https://redwood.internal/compliance/pen-test-attestation-template-2026. If Legal needs a signed attestation, Marco — can you confirm signer?

Marco Li: Signer = Security Ops Director. I’ll prepare the signed PDF once Emma confirms final wording. Also attaching the attestation short template snippet for quick copy:

```
Pen-Test Attestation
Vendor: Redwood Inference
Assessment Period: YYYY-MM
Assessor: [Third-party firm]
Scope: Production inference infrastructure (hosted/dedicated)
Statement: We attest that during the assessment period the scoped infrastructure was tested and no critical findings remained open at time of report issuance.
Signer: Security Ops Director
```

Jordan Patel: For the redacted SOC2 exec summary, I removed customer-identifying bits and IAAS provider specifics. It still shows control coverage. That should be fine for procurement.

Priya Rao: Perfect. Can we target sending the redacted bundle + SOW stub within 24 hours? I’ll ask BigBank procurement to sign a basic NDA if they need full reports.

AuditBot: New evidence request logged: REQ-2026-112 — assigned to Emma Torres and Marco Li.

Emma Torres: Working on it now, will ping when uploads are ready.

Alex Kim: FYI — if they ask about timeline for Dedicated pricing, point them to the dedicated quote template (SE to follow). Keep me in the loop for renewal/commit negotiation.

Priya Rao: Thanks everyone — I’ll update BigBank and circle back here once I hear from their legal. :pray:
